title: Homogeneous generator formulas for the concrete finite tensor shifts
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and a scheme W in the same universe, the explicit finite maps [def-pod-tensor-finite-signed-shifts] satisfy PodTensorFiniteShiftGenerators. For all cochain complexes P,Q, quotient levels n, homogeneous degrees p,q, integer shifts r, site objects U and sections x,y, the first-factor map sends the (p,q) pure tensor to the (p+r,q) pure tensor, and the second-factor map sends it to (-1)^(p*r) times the (p,q+r) pure tensor. Heterogeneous equality only transports the equal total-degree indices.

source.place: Steps 1 and 5; signed shifts of the same representative-normalized tensor operation. Supporting calculation: Stacks homology.tex, definition-shift-cochain, and more-algebra.tex, item-shift-tensor; descent: sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-pullback-tensor-product.

proof.text: Insert the ordinary reduction shift isomorphism into Mathlib’s first- or second-factor total tensor shift. The ordinary shift comparisons have identity components; the native total tensor inclusion formulas give coefficients one and (-1)^(p*r), respectively. Apply the resulting module-map equality to the pure tensor section. Transport along equality of the total indices; scalar restriction leaves the underlying section maps unchanged. The proof is implemented by finiteShiftLeft_generators and finiteShiftRight_generators, using the already proved TensorTotalProof.totalTensor_map.
